scope: Actual-Metal isolated plane traction operator verification in normalized units, sphere radius one. Independent analytical sphere-cap force, torque and normal work; prescribed nodal history continuation, separation/return, Coulomb loss and common rigid-frame rotation. Full one-sided area weighting is an explicit project extension of continuum traction integration, not an assertion of equivalence to the published benchmark wall algorithm. Final 32768-node force, torque and normal energy errors bounded by 0.1% of the declared analytical scales; all coarser observations retained. No particle advancement, plane motion driver, nonperiodic neighbour search, integrated reactions/checkpoints/rollback, restitution, assembly or material qualification.
